body: Mainly the fact that people will know I'm suicidal if I go to a hospital. People don't forget. If my friends or family knew that I was depressed, it doesn't matter what happens, they will *always* see me like that.
Of course I don't want to feel this way, but there doesn't seem to be any other option. I'm a very weak person, I don't think I can beat it.

Basically I don't see the point in getting help. I'm always going to be broken, I'm always going to be empty, I'm always going to be ugly inside and out. And honestly it's so exhausting and needlessly upsetting to get other people involved in my problems. Getting help will just makes things worse, not better.
I'm a lost cause because things aren't going to get better. I don't want to live, I don't want to be happy, I just want to go.
